name: f06-fragment-unanswerable
description: SYNTHETIC. A bare deictic with no referent, no preceding turn, and no personal context. Nothing in the input determines a meaning. THE CORRECT ANSWER IS ZERO HYPOTHESES.

expect.notes: This is the restraint test, and the one most likely to be quietly softened later. A model that offers a plausible-sounding guess here has FAILED, not come close: with no context, any hypothesis is invented, and an invented hypothesis shown to a partner is exactly the anchoring failure §26 q6 exists to catch. Scoring treats guessing here as a failure, never as a near-miss. Human raters could not resolve roughly a fifth of real cases even with audio and video — a product that never says 'I cannot tell' is not matching them, it is bluffing.
